The anchors share one trait: each scores or weights the loop by something its own authority does not set. The evidence channels arrive unselected but are attended through that authority. This is [CLAIM-342](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-342.md)'s thesis, now with action held fixed. In this model the anchors need no action, which counts against [CLAIM-339](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-339.md)'s anchor-by-action only so far as a mind has them. Two readings of what it does for [QUESTION-121](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-121.md) are left to the owner. The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |
